'''Revenue''' was a subdivision of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Financial Division]]. It was responsible for collecting the tax revenue from the consumers and businesses within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It was also tasked with distributing payments to all employees, subcontractors, stock holders and sponsors. Revenue also ensured that taxes were paid to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as well as controlling the supply of rare minerals and [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] and setting the currency exchange rate.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
